correctness.rationale: Cooper Table 5 and independent formal eta-product calculations establish exact first five digit-pair multipliers. Beukers–Tsai–Ye Theorem 1.2 establishes Lucas for each integral level-14 sequence. Their unit multipliers form C4×C2; multinomial counts establish each group-cell frequency for every L; finite character orthogonality establishes the exact 2*5^L+5 Parseval numerator and sharp maximal conditional rate. Infinitely many indices follow by inserting neutral high-digit words. A standalone exact-integer checker verified 400 terms, 13 independent formal coefficients per sequence, all 97,656 prefix indices over L=0..7, and the group identity for 24 L values. Finite checks are consistency tests, not substitutes for the full published Lucas theorem or the algebraic proof.
